exposure: maternal colonization by Group B beta-hemolytic Streptococcus (GBS)
cohort: The study included 190 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies who delivered spontaneously preterm (<37 weeks gestation).
finding: No significant association was found between GBS culture status (presence/absence or positive/negative result) or GBS prophylaxis adequacy, and the prevalence of adverse maternal/perinatal outcomes.
